Scaled monthly marketing volume from approximately $200,000 to $800,000 while improving ROAS from 1.5 to 3.5 through bidding, audience, budget and conversion work. Managed a portfolio of more than 75 client accounts and built reporting that turns performance data into practical recommendations. Combines funnel testing, competitive research, automated analysis and hands-on commerce systems work to support accountable client growth.
